en.text: Now there were some present at the same time who told him about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.

zhSimplified.text: 正当那时，有人将彼拉多使加利利人的血搀杂在他们祭物中的事告诉耶稣。

zhTraditional.text: 正當那時，有人將彼拉多使加利利人的血攙雜在他們祭物中的事告訴耶穌。

en.text: Jesus answered them, “Doyou think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans, because they suffered such things?

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣说：「你们以为这些加利利人比众加利利人更有罪，所以受这害吗？

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌說：「你們以為這些加利利人比眾加利利人更有罪，所以受這害嗎？

en.text: Itell you, no, but unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.

zhSimplified.text: 我告诉你们，不是的！你们若不悔改，都要如此灭亡！

zhTraditional.text: 我告訴你們，不是的！你們若不悔改，都要如此滅亡！

en.text: Orthose eighteen on whom the tower in Siloam fell and killed them —do you think that they were worse offenders than all the men who dwell in Jerusalem?

zhSimplified.text: 从前西罗亚楼倒塌了，压死十八个人；你们以为那些人比一切住在耶路撒冷的人更有罪吗？

zhTraditional.text: 從前西羅亞樓倒塌了，壓死十八個人；你們以為那些人比一切住在耶路撒冷的人更有罪嗎？

en.text: Itell you, no, but, unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.”

zhSimplified.text: 我告诉你们，不是的！你们若不悔改，都要如此灭亡！」

zhTraditional.text: 我告訴你們，不是的！你們若不悔改，都要如此滅亡！」

en.text: He spoke this parable. “Acertain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard, and he came seeking fruit on it and found none.

zhSimplified.text: 于是用比喻说：「一个人有一棵无花果树栽在葡萄园里。他来到树前找果子，却找不着。

zhTraditional.text: 於是用比喻說：「一個人有一棵無花果樹栽在葡萄園裏。他來到樹前找果子，卻找不着。

en.text: Hesaid to the vine dresser, ‘Behold, these three years I have come looking for fruit on this fig tree, and found none. Cut it down! Why does it waste the soil?’

zhSimplified.text: 就对管园的说：『看哪，我这三年来到这无花果树前找果子，竟找不着。把它砍了吧，何必白占地土呢！』

zhTraditional.text: 就對管園的說：『看哪，我這三年來到這無花果樹前找果子，竟找不着。把它砍了吧，何必白佔地土呢！』

en.text: Heanswered, ‘Lord, leave it alone this year also, until I dig around it and fertilize it.

zhSimplified.text: 管园的说：『主啊，今年且留着，等我周围掘开土，加上粪；

zhTraditional.text: 管園的說：『 主啊，今年且留着，等我周圍掘開土，加上糞；

en.text: Ifit bears fruit, fine; but if not, after that, you can cut it down.’”

zhSimplified.text: 以后若结果子便罢，不然再把它砍了。』」

zhTraditional.text: 以後若結果子便罷，不然再把它砍了。』」

en.text: He was teaching in one of the synagogues on the Sabbath day.

zhSimplified.text: 安息日，耶稣在会堂里教训人。

zhTraditional.text: 安息日，耶穌在會堂裏教訓人。

en.text: Behold, there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years. She was bent over and could in no way straighten herself up.

zhSimplified.text: 有一个女人被鬼附着，病了十八年，腰弯得一点直不起来。

zhTraditional.text: 有一個女人被鬼附着，病了十八年，腰彎得一點直不起來。

en.text: When Jesus saw her, he called her and said to her, “Woman, you are freed from your infirmity.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣看见，便叫过她来，对她说：「女人，你脱离这病了！」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌看見，便叫過她來，對她說：「女人，你脫離這病了！」

en.text: He laid his hands on her, and immediately she stood up straight and glorified God.

zhSimplified.text: 于是用两只手按着她；她立刻直起腰来，就归荣耀与 神。

zhTraditional.text: 於是用兩隻手按着她；她立刻直起腰來，就歸榮耀與上帝。

en.text: The ruler of the synagogue, being indignant because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath, said to the multitude, “There are six days in which men ought to work. Therefore come on those days and be healed, and not on the Sabbath day!”

zhSimplified.text: 管会堂的因为耶稣在安息日治病，就气忿忿地对众人说：「有六日应当做工；那六日之内可以来求医，在安息日却不可。」

zhTraditional.text: 管會堂的因為耶穌在安息日治病，就氣忿忿地對眾人說：「有六日應當做工；那六日之內可以來求醫，在安息日卻不可。」

en.text: Therefore the Lord answered him, “Youhypocrites! Doesn’t each one of you free his ox or his donkey from the stall on the Sabbath and lead him away to water?

zhSimplified.text: 主说：「假冒为善的人哪，难道你们各人在安息日不解开槽上的牛、驴，牵去饮吗？

zhTraditional.text: 主說：「假冒為善的人哪，難道你們各人在安息日不解開槽上的牛、驢，牽去飲嗎？

en.text: Oughtnot this woman, being a daughter of Abraham whom Satan had bound eighteen long years, be freed from this bondage on the Sabbath day?”

zhSimplified.text: 况且这女人本是亚伯拉罕的后裔，被撒但捆绑了这十八年，不当在安息日解开她的绑吗？」

zhTraditional.text: 況且這女人本是亞伯拉罕的後裔，被撒但捆綁了這十八年，不當在安息日解開她的綁嗎？」

en.text: As he said these things, all his adversaries were disappointed; and all the multitude rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣说这话，他的敌人都惭愧了；众人因他所行一切荣耀的事，就都欢喜了。 （太13·31—33；可4·30—32）

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌說這話，他的敵人都慚愧了；眾人因他所行一切榮耀的事，就都歡喜了。 （太13‧31－33；可4‧30－32）

en.text: He said, “Whatis God’s Kingdom like? To what shall I compare it?

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣说：「 神的国好像什么？我拿什么来比较呢？

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌說：「上帝的國好像甚麼？我拿甚麼來比較呢？

en.text: Itis like a grain of mustard seed which a man took and put in his own garden. It grew and became a large tree, and the birds of the sky live in its branches.”

zhSimplified.text: 好像一粒芥菜种，有人拿去种在园子里，长大成树，天上的飞鸟宿在它的枝上。」

zhTraditional.text: 好像一粒芥菜種，有人拿去種在園子裏，長大成樹，天上的飛鳥宿在它的枝上。」

en.text: Again he said, “Towhat shall I compare God’s Kingdom?

zhSimplified.text: 又说：「我拿什么来比 神的国呢？

zhTraditional.text: 又說：「我拿甚麼來比上帝的國呢？

en.text: Itis like yeast, which a woman took and hid in three measures offlour, until it was all leavened.”

footnotes.text: 13:21 literally, three sata. 3 sata is about 39 liters or a bit more than a bushel.

zhSimplified.text: 好比面酵，有妇人拿来藏在三斗面里，直等全团都发起来。」 （太7·13—14，21—23）

zhTraditional.text: 好比麵酵，有婦人拿來藏在三斗麵裏，直等全團都發起來。」 （太7‧13－14，21－23）

en.text: He went on his way through cities and villages, teaching, and traveling on to Jerusalem.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣往耶路撒冷去，在所经过的各城各乡教训人。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌往耶路撒冷去，在所經過的各城各鄉教訓人。

en.text: One said to him, “Lord, are they few who are saved?” He said to them,

zhSimplified.text: 有一个人问他说：「主啊，得救的人少吗？」

zhTraditional.text: 有一個人問他說：「主啊，得救的人少嗎？」

en.text: “Strive toenter in by the narrow door, for many, I tell you, will seek to enter in and will not be able.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣对众人说：「你们要努力进窄门。我告诉你们，将来有许多人想要进去，却是不能。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌對眾人說：「你們要努力進窄門。我告訴你們，將來有許多人想要進去，卻是不能。

en.text: Whenonce the master of the house has risen up and has shut the door, and you begin to stand outside and to knock at the door, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us!’ then he will answer and tell you, ‘I don’ t know you or where you come from.’

zhSimplified.text: 及至家主起来关了门，你们站在外面叩门，说：『主啊，给我们开门！』他就回答说：『我不认识你们，不晓得你们是哪里来的！』

zhTraditional.text: 及至家主起來關了門，你們站在外面叩門，說：『主啊，給我們開門！』他就回答說：『我不認識你們，不曉得你們是哪裏來的！』

en.text: Thenyou will begin to say, ‘We ate and drank in your presence, and you taught in our streets.’

zhSimplified.text: 那时，你们要说：『我们在你面前吃过喝过，你也在我们的街上教训过人。』

zhTraditional.text: 那時，你們要說：『我們在你面前吃過喝過，你也在我們的街上教訓過人。』

en.text: Hewill say, ‘I tell you, I don’t know where you come from. Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity.’

zhSimplified.text: 他要说：『我告诉你们，我不晓得你们是哪里来的。你们这一切作恶的人，离开我去吧！』

zhTraditional.text: 他要說：『我告訴你們，我不曉得你們是哪裏來的。你們這一切作惡的人，離開我去吧！』

en.text: Therewill be weeping and gnashing of teeth when you see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in God’s Kingdom, and yourselves being thrown outside.

zhSimplified.text: 你们要看见亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各，和众先知都在 神的国里，你们却被赶到外面，在那里必要哀哭切齿了。

zhTraditional.text: 你們要看見亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各，和眾先知都在上帝的國裏，你們卻被趕到外面，在那裏必要哀哭切齒了。

en.text: Theywill come from the east, west, north, and south, and will sit down in God’s Kingdom.

zhSimplified.text: 从东、从西、从南、从北将有人来，在 神的国里坐席。

zhTraditional.text: 從東、從西、從南、從北將有人來，在上帝的國裏坐席。

en.text: Behold, there are some who are last who will be first, and there are some who are first who will be last.”

zhSimplified.text: 只是有在后的，将要在前；有在前的，将要在后。」 （太23·37—39）

zhTraditional.text: 只是有在後的，將要在前；有在前的，將要在後。」 （太23‧37－39）

en.text: On that same day, some Pharisees came, saying to him, “Get out of here and go away, for Herod wants to kill you.”

zhSimplified.text: 正当那时，有几个法利赛人来对耶稣说：「离开这里去吧，因为希律想要杀你。」

zhTraditional.text: 正當那時，有幾個法利賽人來對耶穌說：「離開這裏去吧，因為希律想要殺你。」

en.text: He said to them, “Goand tell that fox, ‘Behold, I cast out demons and perform cures today and tomorrow, and the third day I complete my mission.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣说：「你们去告诉那个狐狸说：『今天、明天我赶鬼治病，第三天我的事就成全了。』

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌說：「你們去告訴那個狐狸說：『今天、明天我趕鬼治病，第三天我的事就成全了。』

en.text: NeverthelessI must go on my way today and tomorrow and the next day, for it can’ t be that a prophet would perish outside of Jerusalem.’

zhSimplified.text: 虽然这样，今天、明天、后天，我必须前行，因为先知在耶路撒冷之外丧命是不能的。

zhTraditional.text: 雖然這樣，今天、明天、後天，我必須前行，因為先知在耶路撒冷之外喪命是不能的。

en.text: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I wanted to gather your children together, like a hen gathers her own brood under her wings, and you refused!

zhSimplified.text: 耶路撒冷啊！耶路撒冷啊！你常杀害先知，又用石头打死那奉差遣到你这里来的人。我多次愿意聚集你的儿女，好像母鸡把小鸡聚集在翅膀底下；只是你们不愿意。

zhTraditional.text: 耶路撒冷啊！耶路撒冷啊！你常殺害先知，又用石頭打死那奉差遣到你這裏來的人。我多次願意聚集你的兒女，好像母雞把小雞聚集在翅膀底下；只是你們不願意。

en.text: Behold, your house is left to you desolate. I tell you, you will not see me until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’”

zhSimplified.text: 看哪，你们的家成为荒场留给你们。我告诉你们，从今以后你们不得再见我，直等到你们说：『奉主名来的是应当称颂的。』」

zhTraditional.text: 看哪，你們的家成為荒場留給你們。我告訴你們，從今以後你們不得再見我，直等到你們說：『奉主名來的是應當稱頌的。』」
